response: Prostate morphology does affect outcomes after holmium laser enucleation. Specifically, patients with trilobar prostate morphology are more likely to achieve a greater decrease in post-void residual (PVR) urine volume after the procedure. However, all other outcomes appear to be similar between patients with different prostate morphologies. Additionally, a 2-lobe technique can be safely used for trilobar prostates when deemed feasible by the surgeon.
